assessment: Gain of function mutations in NLRP3 are associated with a group of autoinflammatory diseases called the cryopyrin-associated periodic syndromes (CAPS). Karasawa and colleagues reveal that CAPS-associated NLRP3 mutants form cryo-sensitive aggregates that promote NLRP3 inflammasome assembly and Caspase-1 activation through elegant immunofluorescence studies, providing mechanistic insights into CAPS.
